name: Kalinga War
description: Ashoka's conquest of Kalinga is traditionally dated to around 261 BCE. The war is associated with Ashoka's later moral and political transformation.
certainty: Date and details are based on historical reconstruction.

name: Tripartite Struggle
description: A prolonged contest among three major powers for influence over Kannauj and northern India.
certainty: Multi-phase conflict; not a single battle.

name: Second Battle of Tarain
description: Muhammad of Ghor defeated Prithviraj Chauhan's forces in a decisive battle.

name: Battle of Panipat (1526)
description: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi, establishing Mughal power in North India.

name: Battle of Talikota
description: A major defeat for Vijayanagara forces; the political consequences unfolded over subsequent years.

name: Battle of Haldighati
outcome: Mughal tactical victory; Mewar resistance continued
description: A battle between Mughal forces and Maharana Pratap's Mewar army.
certainty: Outcome is often discussed with nuance.

name: Third Battle of Panipat
description: A major 18th-century battle that weakened Maratha expansion in North India.

name: Fourth Anglo-Mysore War
description: Tipu Sultan was killed during the siege of Srirangapatna; Mysore's political arrangement was restructured.
certainty: Siege and battle locations are approximate.

name: First Anglo-Sikh War
description: A war that ended with the Treaty of Lahore and major political changes in Punjab.
certainty: Multiple battles; marker indicates the broad theatre.
